items.title: File Widerspruch against the accident recognition decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated and posted on Friday 20.11.2026 (no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date is given, so the printed letter date is the posting day). This is a decision by a social-insurance body (Unfallkasse / gesetzliche Unfallversicherung), governed by § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X: deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting, and for non-tax authorities this delivery day is NOT shifted even if it falls on a weekend/holiday. Counting calendar days from 20.11.2026 (day 0, not counted): 21.11 (Sat, day1), 22.11 (Sun, day2), 23.11 (Mon, day3), 24.11 (Tue, day4) -> deemed delivery (Bekanntgabe) = Tuesday 24.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruch period (§ 26 Abs. 1 SGB X i.V.m. §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB) starts the day after delivery and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 24.12.2026. Checking weekday: 24.11.2026 is a Tuesday (today), so 24.12.2026 falls on a Thursday - not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday (24 December is a normal working day), so the end date does not shift (§ 26 Abs. 3 SGB X / § 193 BGB not triggered).
